_help: Chat window (official UI/StatusBar3.img/chat art). Game pixels in 1366x768. x,y = the window top-left. The tab row sits on top, the log frame under it, the input line at the bottom. logPadX/logPadY = the gap from the frame edge to the text. lineH = the height of one log line. nameGap = the gap between the name and the text of a line. caretDx/caretDy/caretW/caretH = the caret box in the input line. border = the corner size of the nine piece frame. capW = the width of the left and right cap of the input bar. btnW/btnGap = the input buttons on the right of the input line (the settings button, the three official window buttons and the minimise button). minW/minH = the size of the minimised chat. fieldX = the left edge of the input field (the official spot: the chat target button is 60 wide at x=6, the field starts at x=71). targetX/targetY = the spot of the chat target button (it sends the line to the party instead of the world).
